about_the_game:
Kamiko was never the kind of girl people understood.
Now she’s dead—and still waiting for someone to really listen.

They say her death was an accident.
They say she’s at peace.
But they’re wrong.

Tonight, you’ve been sent to speak with her.
Not as a friend. Not as family. As a stranger who hears the dead.

There are things Kamiko never said while she was alive.

Now, you’re the only one who might hear them.

Through quiet, haunting conversations, you’ll uncover what she remembers—and what she doesn’t.

You’ll choose how to respond. You’ll decide how much truth she can handle.
You’ll help her face the question she keeps avoiding:
Why is she still here?

There will be confessions.
There will be buried pain.
There will be answers that feel a little too real.

 This is a visual novel about quiet ghosts, unseen pain, and the weight of being forgotten.
If you’re looking for emotional slow-burn storytelling, hidden truths, and endings that linger—this is it.

Some spirits aren’t lost—they’re just waiting for someone who’ll finally listen.
Your words shape what Kamiko becomes in the end.

There are no easy answers.
Only what’s left behind.

This is a short story.
Of invisibility. Of resentment. Of wanting to be seen, even after it’s too late.
It all happens in one night.
And it might never leave you.

GAME FEATURES:

  • 🌙 10 emotionally branching questions that reveal Kamiko’s past

  • 🌸 8 unique endings based on affection and trust

  • 👻 A single expressive sprite: Kamiko, cold and gothic—but vulnerable underneath

  • 🕯️ A night. A spirit. And last conversation

  • 💬 30-40 minutes to experience all paths, each one unraveling a different ending of Kamiko

“One night. One spirit. One final chance to be heard.”
